questions.q: What is the breath of life that the Most High breathed into Adam (Genesis 2:7)?
choices: The light of the first day
questions.explain: The breath of life is talking about the commandments. This is Adam, the chosen.

questions.q: Which river compasses the whole land of Ethiopia (Genesis 2:13)?
questions.explain: The river Gihon is the Blue Nile; it compasses the whole land of Ethiopia.

questions.q: What does the class say some of the trees of the garden represent?
questions.explain: Some of these trees are literal trees, and some represent men. Scripture uses trees to represent men (Mark 8:24).

questions.q: What does it show that there was no help meet right for Adam among the women on the earth (Genesis 2:18-20)?
choices: There were more people on the earth than Adam alone
Adam was the only man ever created
Women were made after the animals
questions.explain: The Most High looked at the women on the earth and there was no help meet right for Adam; there were more people on the earth than Adam alone.

questions.q: What does Genesis 2:1-3 record for the first time in scripture?
choices: The Sabbath: the Most High blessed the seventh day and sanctified it
questions.explain: This is the first Sabbath you read about in the scriptures.
